humanoid.name: Humanoid
humanoid.description: Stands on two legs with two free hands: armor from head to toe, a ring, a necklace, and a weapon

quadruped.name: Quadruped
quadruped.description: Four legs and no hands: a collar and barding, never a weapon

avian.name: Avian
avian.description: Wings and talons, too light to carry gear

serpentine.name: Serpentine
serpentine.description: A limbless coil that nothing stays on

arachnid.name: Arachnid
arachnid.description: Eight legs under a hard shell

insect.name: Insect
insect.description: Six legs under a hard shell

amorphous.name: Amorphous
amorphous.description: No fixed shape; whatever it touches sinks in

draconic.name: Draconic
draconic.description: Scales, wings, and claws; it hoards gear rather than wearing it

plant.name: Plant
plant.description: Rooted bark, vine, and leaf; nothing to buckle on
